title: SetError missing PartialEq despite SetErrorType having it — inconvenient for tests
description: backend.rs:52: SetError derives Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize but not PartialEq. SetErrorType (which is the most important field) does derive PartialEq. Test code that wants to assert on the error type must destructure or call .error_type, instead of using assert_eq! directly. This is a mild but unnecessary friction. Fix: add PartialEq to the derive list on SetError.
